title: Twelve products, four dimensions
description: one hairline = one product across price · satisfaction · retention · growth · ink = the one that wins everywhere

props.name: data
props.description: Product labels and one finite reading per dimension. Incomplete rows stay unavailable; readings outside the reference ranges are extrapolated without changing those ranges. Repeated labels remain separate observations.

props.name: dimensions
props.description: At least two labeled finite min/max ranges, with at least one scored dimension. The highlighted complete product maximizes the sum of normalized scored values; unscored dimensions such as price do not affect the result.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
